requirements:
This model describes a file system.
It represents oily system elements which can be a folders or files. All file system elements have a name. Every file system element must belong to a folder, and folders can aggregate any number of file system elements. Files have information about their extension and their size.

issues.message: FileSystemElement is defined as an abstract base class in the intermediate model description but is not marked as abstract in the class definition.
issues.evidence: It represents oily system elements which can be a folders or files.
suggestions: Set 'is_abstract' to true for FileSystemElement in the intermediate model and add 'abstract' keyword in PlantUML.
issues.description: FileSystemElement is defined as an abstract base class in the intermediate model description but is not marked as abstract in the class definition.
issues.evidence_from_requirements: It represents oily system elements which can be a folders or files.
issues.suggested_fix: Set 'is_abstract' to true for FileSystemElement in the intermediate model and add 'abstract' keyword in PlantUML.

issues.message: Redundant relationship: The model defines both a composition 'contains' and an association 'belongs to' between Folder and FileSystemElement, which creates a circular dependency and logical redundancy.
issues.evidence: Every file system element must belong to a folder, and folders can aggregate any number of file system elements.
suggestions: Remove the 'belongs to' association as it is implicitly covered by the composition relationship.
